---
name: Content issue
about: Manual disagrees with the source book (Rondinelli & Lauren's *Encyclopedia of Double Bass Drumming*), or is internally inconsistent. This is the same category as the existing content-issues.md log.
title: "[content] "
labels: content-issue
---

## Where in the manual

File and section/exercise number, e.g. "chapter-01.md, Core table, Ex. 1" or "approach.md §4, clean-pass rule".

## What the manual says

Quote the specific line(s) you are flagging.

## What you believe is correct

If the manual disagrees with R&L, cite the R&L page. If the manual is internally inconsistent (e.g. two sections give different starting bpm for the same exercise), point at both.

## Which edition of R&L

If relevant: Revised Edition (default) or Original Edition. See [approach.md §3.2](../approach.md#32-original-edition-compatibility) for what the manual assumes.

## Anything else

Optional. Skip if you have nothing to add.
